text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired -> pd:PD-98765 (embeddings-queue-eu). Severity: P1. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-98765

pagerduty: Incident PD-98765 created by alert rule 'embeddings-queue-latency-high'. Assigned to rotation: eng-oncall-eu.

Maya Chen: acked. I'm on it, jumping into the bridge. 

Samir Patel: thx Maya. I'll monitor traffic and customer signals, standing by for handoff if you need it. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: quick snapshot: k8s queue depth spiking on embedder-prod-eu-1, pods reporting OOMs, autoscaler not spawning fast enough. Potentially related to yesterday's model rollout.

Jonah Reyes: pinged infra to check GPU memory pressure on pool 'dedicated-emb-3'. They saw 92% GPU mem on node-07.

Lina Gomez: customer-impact check: CS reports 4 customers with elevated error rates (~3-6% of requests). No major outages yet but increased latency to 3s p95. Notifying AMs.

Maya Chen: plan: 1) scale up replica set to +3 (manual) 2) drain node-07 if mem flapping 3) rollback model replica -> previous quantized variant if memory remains high. Who can run the scale command?

Samir Patel: I can run the scale and watch. Running:
```
kubectl scale deploy/embedder-prod --replicas=12 -n inference-prod-eu
```

Samir Patel: scaled to 12, API returned 202. Watching pod startup logs.

incidentbot: Bridge created: https://zoom.example/bridges/PD-98765 (auto-bridge).

Jonah Reyes: infra confirmed node-07 GPU leak suspected, cordon in progress. Command:
```
kubectl cordon node-07 && kubectl drain node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

Jonah Reyes: cordon/drain started, one heavy pod evicted; kube rescheduled to new nodes.

Maya Chen: after scaling + drain, p95 latency dropped to 900ms, errors down to 0.8% — continuing to monitor for 10m.

Lina Gomez: AM update drafted and sent to affected customers: short note about transient embedding delays, mitigation in progress, follow-up to come.

Samir Patel: quick health check: embedder pool CPU fine, GPU mem on remaining nodes stable ~60%. No further OOMs observed in last 3 mins.

Maya Chen: assigning ownership: I'll stay on primary until handoff. If anyone needs to take over (oncall shift change incoming), ping me before 16:30 UTC.

Jonah Reyes: noted. I'll keep infra on standby for repro/rollback.

Lina Gomez: customer impact ticket updated with mitigation notes and ETA to full recovery ~+30m.

Maya Chen: marking PD incident as acknowledged and in mitigation. Will update again after 30m or on any regression. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-98765 status: Acknowledged by Maya Chen.

Samir Patel: thanks — leaving small runbook note in incident: suspect model rollout -> memory spike -> manual scale + node drain fixed. Recommend rollback in case of recurrence.

Maya Chen: adding runbook step now.

Maya Chen: final: holding until 16:20 UTC, then if stable I'll close the PD and postmortem task. Thanks team. :pray:

incidentbot: PD-98765 last update recorded at 3159876699.
